name: Party Standee: "Popular Idol"
description: A dancer standee serving as a landmark for the dance party co-hosted by the People of the Springs, the Children of Echoes, and the Flower-Feather Clan at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort. It faithfully captures the sweet movements and expressions of Mondstadt's popular idol, Barbara.\n"Light, floaty, and shiny! That's the feeling she gives off." No matter where they hail from, anyone watching Barbara dance would surely be moved to utter such praise...\nTrying out unfamiliar steps and discovering unexpected dynamism in seemingly simple movements — it is this very thrill of artistic exchange that unites the event's organizers.
